fb2S: Tell us anything you want changed, in any language. We read it and show below what we understood. Only the owner approves changes to a forecast, number, rule, money or tax.
fbPrompt: What should we change, or what is missing?
fbNone: You have not sent anything yet.
reading: We are reading this. It appears here within a minute.
cannotRead: We could not read this one. Please send it again in other words.
notSent: Not sent. Check the connection and press Send again.
ownerOnly: Waiting for the owner to approve.
